rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things that are not the same, distinct from one another, or noticeably unlike the usual.

example.traditional: 呢兩杯咖啡個味道唔同。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 go3 mei6 dou6 m4 tung4

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize that two things are not the same, rather than simply describing them as different.

example.english: Look carefully, these two photos are really different.
example.traditional: 你睇清楚，呢兩張相真係唔一樣。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 cing1 co2 ni1 loeng5 zoeng1 soeng2 zan1 hai6 m4 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this for a collection containing various or assorted kinds, rather than for a simple contrast between two things.

example.english: There are different kinds of phone cases in the mall.
example.traditional: 商場入面有各式各樣嘅手機殼。
example.jyutping: soeng1 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6 ge3 sau2 gei1 hok3

rows.note: Use this when ‘different’ means unusual or distinctive, especially when the difference stands out as notable or special.

example.english: Their look today is very different.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 go3 zou6 jing4 hou2 dak6 bit6
